expedition: Oceano Profundo 2018: Exploring Deep-Sea Habitats off Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands
purpose: observations on the geology of Mona Canyon to those made during previous dives in the canyon off the E/V ​Nautilus​ in 2013 and NOAA Ship O​ keanos Explorer​ in 2015. The second part included a series of midwater transects at depths between 2,000 m and 300 m in order to explore the pelagic fauna of the area.
